title: Unit – 5 : Session – 4 : SLO – 2  |  Symbolic Expressions and Algebraic Structures
sections: 1. Symbolic expression — a mathematical expression built from symbolic variables (declared with sympy.symbols) that is stored unevaluated, e.g. x, y = symbols('x y'); expr = x**2 + 2*y.

2. Algebraic structure — a set equipped with one or more operations satisfying specific axioms, e.g. a group (closure, associativity, identity, inverse), a ring (addition + multiplication), or a field (a ring with multiplicative inverses).
